name: You Are A Royal Priesthood
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are called to be a royal priesthood, a holy nation set apart to serve God with reverence and dedication. From the Old Testament promise that Israel would be a kingdom of priests (Exodus 19:6) to the New Testament affirmation that through Christ we are made kings and priests who reign and serve God (Revelation 1:6; 5:10), this identity involves both spiritual authority and sacrificial living (Romans 12:1). Those who share in Christ's resurrection are blessed to minister as priests alongside Him, exercising godly dominion and worship (Revelation 20:6).
